What you already own

Your clothes, their colours and how they fit. A piece with its colour set can be worn in the Outfit tab. A piece with a size chart is used to check the sizes picked for you.

A star marks your favourite of each kind, the one piece you'd clone.

How wide you wear things (cm, garment laid flat)

Most streetwear brands list the garment's width, not your body's. The ranges below are the narrowest and widest you wear. You get your usual size when it falls inside that range, and a different one when a brand cuts wider or narrower than that. Favourite is the one piece you'd clone: star it in “What you already own” and its width and length are filled in here.

    Your measurements (cm)

    These are estimates worked out from the clothes you already wear, not from a tape measure. If you ever measure yourself, type the real numbers in and every answer updates.
